title: 12.4. Hetuduka, Saññojanadukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahetuṁ nosaññojanaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… nahetuṁ noganthaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ. Sabbattha nava.)
Nahetuṁ nooghaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… nahetuṁ noyogaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ. Sabbattha nava. Vipākaṁ natthi.)
Nahetuṁ nonīvaraṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ. Sabbattha nava.)
Nahetuṁ noparāmāsaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ. Sabbattha nava. Vipākaṁ natthi.)
